scope: current source-packet source-review gate dry run; no OCR extraction, key candidates, hashing, WIF, seed, address, BIP39, or broad brute force

reopenGates.name: source identity
reopenGates.passCondition: new material must be physically/original-layout distinct from the byte-locked current scan

reopenGates.name: target preservation
reopenGates.passCondition: must preserve or clearly explain O5, G5, L26-L29, and the p78 frame contact pattern

reopenGates.name: unit/order evidence
reopenGates.passCondition: must name or visibly supply the extraction unit/order before any key checks resume

reopenGates.name: orientation discipline
reopenGates.passCondition: must state whether coordinates are readable/upright or native/source and apply the 180-degree guardrail

reopenGates.name: controlled improvement
reopenGates.passCondition: must improve a compact benchmark, preferably dx -38/-40 G5 edge repair, O5 bottom contact, M3 right-edge cut, or the p77 one-line near miss

minimumReopenConditions.requiredEvidence: source/clue text or source-visible layout must name a unit/order such as word, letter, line, edge, font, first/last, left/right, or equivalent
minimumReopenConditions.why: Without this, local geometry only repeats target discovery.

minimumReopenConditions.requiredEvidence: physical scan/photo/hold-to-light/spread should create repeated direct O5/G5 contacts or improve the p77 71.93px near miss under one natural transform
minimumReopenConditions.why: Current best scan gives zero true physical O5/G5 overlaps.

minimumReopenConditions.requiredEvidence: original Canva/export/browser/source asset must exceed thumbnail status and visibly resolve the #0, p79 pills, XX/barbed-wire, or p78 frame benchmarks
minimumReopenConditions.why: The current Canva surface is only a 668x376 investigator note thumbnail.

minimumReopenConditions.requiredEvidence: new source should naturally preserve or explain `should sell | Volcano Bonds | shitcoiner at heart`, current O5 clip, M3 right-edge cut, and dx≈-38/-40 G5 edge repair
minimumReopenConditions.why: This is the compactest existing registration signature.

protocol.requiredObservation: Confirm the item is materially new physical/original-layout/source evidence, not a duplicate or resaved current scan.
Normalize orientation: readable/upright O4/B4/G5/O5 must preserve lines 22/25/27/32, corridors 4/7/9/14, dx/dy -++/+++.
Reject matches that only reproduce YKKY/OBBO/OVER; require the stricter contiguous Y/K window and 3/2/5 line-gap controls.
Show target preservation and controlled improvement without broad context leakage or p75/OVERDOSE control reproduction.
Find source-backed wording or layout that names the extraction unit/order before any selector/key checks resume.

rows.blocker: not physically/original-layout distinct; no source-backed unit/order
rows.next: Only score materially new physical/original-layout/source evidence.
Use as validation target after a new source passes R1/R3.

rows.blocker: pattern-only YKKY is controlled; geometry is still registration evidence only
rows.next: Require source wording that names the Y/K frame or active quartet order.

rows.evidence: C9 inside 4/4; p75 control matches mirrored variants None
rows.blocker: OVER/slot effects are controlled by p75 and mirrored/header variants
rows.next: Only reopen if source explicitly links OVERDOSE slots to active boxes and controls fail.

rows.evidence: max full inside None/4; full-cover leakage None/None
rows.blocker: dx repair improves residuals but all-four isolation requires a context-leaky expansion
rows.next: Only reopen if a physical/original source naturally explains the transform.

rows.evidence: DOCM/high-res/crop authority; line-level exact bold matches None
rows.blocker: format witnesses disagree or remain authority layers; no instruction says read bold/highlight
rows.next: Only reopen if source/provenance says read, take, count, or order format units.

rows.evidence: source-backed R3 hits 0; reopen triggers satisfied 0
rows.blocker: no raw/raw-like clue names the extraction unit/order
rows.next: Search only for source wording naming word/letter/line/edge/font/order.

ruledOut: using the current scan or local derivatives as new source evidence
accepting YKKY/OBBO/OVERDOSE pattern matches without the stricter geometry and R3
reopening selector/key work from source-registration benchmarks alone
retained: R1-R5 plus exact reopen trigger order for future source review
decision.nextMove: Future review should begin with this gate order: R1 distinct source, R4 orientation, pattern controls, R2/R5 preservation and controlled improvement, then R3 unit/order. If R3 remains absent, stop before selector/key work.
